_about: Weapons, armor and charms: ONE source of truth for gear. Fields: id, name, slot (weapon / armor / charm), type (icon family: sword, hammer, mace, vest, charm), icon, tint (hex recolor), desc (placeholder until M6-2), price (buy price; sells for half), stats ({stat: flat bonus} added to the growth-table stats), owner (weapons and character-only armor: only this party member may equip it; empty = anyone), weight (armor: light / heavy; heavy fits only the characters in heavy_armor_wearers), block_statuses (status ids the wearer cannot catch), perks ({payback_mult: 1.5} etc., read by the battle). Gear never changes Clutch timing. compare: how the up and down arrows (shops and the Equip menu) score a loadout: sum of stat bonuses times stat_weights (default 1), plus status_block_value per blocked status and perk_value per perk. starting_gear is what each fighter wears on a new game (also copied into party/party.json members).
